Hi Beth —

Thanks again for the quick conversation this morning. To keep the AWS Marketplace co-sell onboarding moving, Procurement has asked for the security artifacts that marketplaces typically require: SOC 2 Type II report, a pen-test confirmation letter, and a DPA. Im attaching the standard copies we use for listings and co-sell review.

Action items for NimbusCloud: please confirm whether a single consolidated evidence bundle (SOC2 + pen test letter + signed DPA) is acceptable for your marketplace submission, or if you need any additional attestation (e.g., external audit contact, scope PDF, or encryption/HSM details).

Quick notes:
- SOC2 is the 2024 Type II covering Infra + App controls (audit period Jan–Dec 2024).
- Pen test letter confirms scope against runtime and control plane; its an attestation, not the full pentest report. Happy to coordinate with our security team if you need the redacted report.
- DPA is our standard v3 that supports subprocessor disclosure and EU SCC references.

Attachments: SOC2_Type_II_Report_Redwood_2024.pdf; PenTest_Letter_Redwood_2024.pdf; Redwood_DPA_v3.docx

If procurement would like a short one-page cover note mapping each artifact to AWS Marketplace requirements, we can produce that by Friday.

Best,

Hi Beth —

Quick answers to your questions:

1) SOC2 scope: The SOC 2 covers Redwood-hosted inference workloads and our control plane services. The report lists excluded third-party managed services (e.g., certain partner-managed services) in Section 3. For hosting regions: weve indicated the primary production regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) in the auditor addendum. If youd like, I can export a short scope summary that highlights the region coverage.

2) Pen test letter: The letter included is an attestation from the third-party assessor confirming there were no high-severity unresolved findings at issue date. There were a small number of low/medium items that were remediated within 30 days; we can provide a redacted remediation tracker if Procurement needs it.

3) DPA / EU keys: The DPA v3 supports customer-managed keys and references KMS integrations; however, the DPA is not a KMS configuration guide. For EU residency + CMK, we have a short conops doc (shared link below) and a proposed contractual addendum we can sign if Nimbus needs explicit wording.

Links and attachments: SOC2_Type_II_Report_Redwood_2024.pdf; PenTest_Letter_Redwood_2024.pdf; Redwood_DPA_v3.docx; Conops: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-evidence

If youre ok with this, well:
- Produce a one-page artifact map for Marketplace submission (by EOD Mon 9/15)
- Share a redacted remediation tracker for pen test items (if requested)
- Provide a short addendum draft for CMK residency (if legal requests it)

Looping Laura (legal) for visibility on the DPA follow-up.
